name: Open Trashmail Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed self-hosted disposable/catch-all inbound email server with web inbox, JSON API, RSS feeds, per-address webhooks, attachments and Docker deployment; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiration.
watch_out: Receive-only disposable mail infrastructure, not a hosted email inbox or outbound transactional SMTP provider. Supply your own server, domain, MX/DNS, TLS, storage and backups. Restrict domains with DISCARD_UNKNOWN=true and protect web/API/admin access; otherwise mail and attachments may be exposed or the server may attract abuse. Hosting costs are separate.
